interpretation.decoder_similarity: Near-identical gene-level sensitivity (r=0.96). The decoders are functionally very similar.
interpretation.encoder_divergence: Cross-model MSE is 2.1x worse ? encoders and decoders are co-adapted pairs.
interpretation.perturbation_direction_divergence: Top perturbation directions are nearly orthogonal (cos=-0.26). The encoder-decoder co-adaptation manifests in WHICH direction becomes the steepest descent.
interpretation.erythroid_paradox: Neither model's native top perturbation direction hits erythroid genes well (only 1/50). But s9's direction applied to s11's decoder INCREASES erythroid specificity to 2.33x.
interpretation.core_insight: For perturbation, finding the RIGHT direction matters more than having higher per-gene sensitivity. The encoder-decoder co-adaptation determines which latent direction the Jacobian amplifies.
